template.name: OsMaMaster
template.notes: Documented MACD parameters are used (fast 9, slow 26, signal 5) and the OsMA turning point is approximated by the histogram crossing zero, which is the documented momentum-reversal event. The four Shift parameters select which histogram values are compared and cannot be reproduced without bar shifting, and the 50/50 pip stop and target are pip offsets rather than percentages.
